Read Win-Win Strategies partner FAQ and searched current grants. Women Win co-creates several separately governed funds; ONSIDE’s actual call is indexed in its own source row. A collaboration invitation does not establish a second unrestricted project-grant competition.

Avoided relying on the unrelated redirect and searched the exact fund name/current-year partners. Its donor and Armenian sister-fund records corroborate identity and ongoing feminist partnerships, but no clean fund-owned current policy or award call was recovered. Original integrity warning remains; older EU project calls are historical.

Original directory says no single site and varies by region. Search verified distinct Chicago, Detroit and national Pathways collaboratives; Detroit explicitly does not award grants while Chicago has separate procurements. This is an umbrella category, not a safely identified fund, so none of those policies is assigned.
